id-20260816-intro-real-estate-13.title: [Property #13] A 2% Agent Commission Feels Expensive? Calculate the Cost of a Bad Home Purchase First

segments.src: > Jasa perantara properti berdiri di atas tiga hal: perjanjian yang jelas, komisi yang disepakati di depan, dan pengecekan dokumen yang mencegah sengketa — dan yang ketiga inilah yang paling sering dilewati orang.
segments.tr: > Real estate brokerage services stand on three pillars: a clear agreement, a commission agreed upon upfront, and document verification that prevents disputes — and this third one is most often skipped by people.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Agen properti bukan pemilik barang.
segments.tr: A real estate agent is not the owner of the property.

segments.src: Ia perantara: mempertemukan penjual dan pembeli, lalu dibayar dari jasa mempertemukan itu.
segments.tr: They are an intermediary: bringing the seller and buyer together, and getting paid for that matchmaking service.

segments.src: Karena tidak memiliki barangnya, seluruh pekerjaannya bertumpu pada tiga pilar.
segments.tr: Because they do not own the property, their entire work rests on three pillars.

segments.src: **Pilar 1 — Perjanjian jasa pemasaran (listing).**
segments.tr: **Pillar 1 — Marketing service agreement (listing).**

segments.src: Ini kontrak antara pemilik properti dan agen.
segments.tr: This is a contract between the property owner and the agent.

segments.src: Isinya sederhana tapi menentukan segalanya: harga penawaran, jangka waktu, siapa yang menanggung biaya iklan, dan besaran komisi.
segments.tr: Its contents are simple yet determine everything: asking price, duration, who bears the advertising costs, and the commission amount.

segments.src: Di praktik pasar Indonesia ada tiga bentuk umum:
segments.tr: In the Indonesian market practice, there are three common forms:

segments.src: - **Listing terbuka (open listing):** pemilik menitipkan rumahnya ke banyak agen sekaligus. Yang berhasil menjual, itu yang dapat komisi. Terkesan menguntungkan pemilik, tapi efeknya sering sebaliknya — satu rumah muncul di lima platform dengan lima harga berbeda, dan calon pembeli langsung curiga.
segments.tr: - **Open listing:** the owner entrusts their house to many agents at once. Whoever successfully sells it gets the commission. It seems beneficial to the owner, but the effect is often the opposite — one house appears on five platforms with five different prices, and potential buyers immediately grow suspicious.

segments.src: - **Listing eksklusif:** hanya satu agen selama periode tertentu (biasanya 3–6 bulan). Agen berani keluar biaya foto, video, dan iklan berbayar karena risikonya terukur.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive listing:** only one agent for a certain period (usually 3–6 months). The agent dares to spend money on photos, videos, and paid ads because the risk is measurable.

segments.src: - **Listing bersama (multiple listing):** eksklusif ke satu agen, tapi agen itu membagikan datanya ke jaringan kantor lain dan komisi dibagi antara agen penjual dan agen pembeli.
segments.tr: - **Multiple listing:** exclusive to one agent, but that agent shares the data with other office networks and the commission is split between the selling agent and the buying agent.

segments.src: **Pilar 2 — Komisi (fee jasa perantara).**
segments.tr: **Pillar 2 — Commission (brokerage service fee).**

segments.src: Dasar hukum utamanya di Indonesia adalah Permendag No.
segments.tr: The main legal basis in Indonesia is Trade Minister Regulation No.

segments.src: 51 Tahun 2017 tentang Perusahaan Perantara Perdagangan Properti.
segments.tr: 51 of 2017 concerning Property Brokerage Companies.

segments.src: Aturan itu menetapkan komisi berdasarkan kesepakatan, namun **paling sedikit 2% dari nilai transaksi**, dan dibayar oleh pihak pemberi tugas — umumnya penjual.
segments.tr: That rule sets the commission based on agreement, but **at least 2% of the transaction value**, and is paid by the party giving the assignment — generally the seller.

segments.src: Di pasar sekunder rumah tinggal, angka yang lazim berkisar 2–3%.
segments.tr: In the secondary residential market, the usual figure ranges from 2–3%.

segments.src: Untuk transaksi sewa, praktik pasar biasanya memakai persentase dari nilai sewa setahun, bukan dari harga jual properti.
segments.tr: For rental transactions, market practice usually uses a percentage of the annual rental value, not the property selling price.

segments.src: Yang sering memicu ribut bukan besarannya, melainkan **kapan komisi dianggap lahir**.
segments.tr: What often triggers arguments is not the amount, but **when the commission is considered earned**.

segments.src: Apakah saat pembeli membayar tanda jadi?
segments.tr: Is it when the buyer pays a booking fee?

segments.src: Saat PPJB ditandatangani?
segments.tr: When the PPJB is signed?

segments.src: Atau saat AJB tuntas di hadapan PPAT?
segments.tr: Or when the AJB is completed before the PPAT?

segments.src: Tulis titik itu di perjanjian sejak awal.
segments.tr: Write that point into the agreement from the start.

segments.src: Tulis juga apa yang terjadi kalau transaksi batal karena KPR pembeli ditolak bank.
segments.tr: Also write down what happens if the transaction is canceled because the buyer's mortgage (KPR) is rejected by the bank.

segments.src: **Pilar 3 — Pencegahan sengketa (yang paling sering dilewati).**
segments.tr: **Pillar 3 — Dispute prevention (the most frequently skipped).**

segments.src: Kerugian terbesar di jasa properti hampir tidak pernah datang dari salah pasang harga.
segments.tr: The biggest losses in real estate services almost never come from pricing it wrong.

segments.src: Datangnya dari dokumen.
segments.tr: They come from documents.

segments.src: Daftar periksa minimalnya:
segments.tr: The minimum checklist:

segments.src: - Cek keaslian dan status sertifikat langsung ke Kantor Pertanahan/BPN — bukan cukup melihat fotokopinya.
segments.tr: - Check the authenticity and status of the certificate directly at the Land Office/BPN — not just looking at a photocopy.

segments.src: - Pastikan nama di sertifikat sama dengan KTP penjual. Kalau pemilik sudah meninggal, wajib balik nama waris dulu.
segments.tr: - Make sure the name on the certificate matches the seller's ID (KTP). If the owner has passed away, inheritance name transfer is mandatory first.

segments.src: - Kalau properti adalah harta bersama, butuh persetujuan pasangan secara tertulis.
segments.tr: - If the property is joint marital property, written spouse consent is needed.

segments.src: - Periksa tunggakan PBB, IPL, listrik, dan air.
segments.tr: - Check for arrears on land tax (PBB), building management fees (IPL), electricity, and water.

segments.src: - Pastikan tidak ada blokir, sita, atau sengketa batas.
segments.tr: - Make sure there are no blocks, seizures, or boundary disputes.

segments.src: - Uang pembeli **tidak boleh** masuk ke rekening pribadi agen. Titik.
segments.tr: - Buyer's money **must not** go into the agent's personal account. Period.

segments.src: - Semua uang muka pakai kuitansi dan perjanjian tertulis, dan akta jual beli dibuat di hadapan PPAT.
segments.tr: - All down payments use receipts and written agreements, and the deed of sale is made before the PPAT.

segments.src: Agen yang legal juga punya izin usaha perantara properti (SIU-P4) dan sertifikat kompetensi.
segments.tr: A legal agent also has a property brokerage business license (SIU-P4) and a competency certificate.

segments.src: Menanyakannya bukan tindakan kurang sopan — itu bagian dari uji tuntas Anda.
segments.tr: Asking for them is not impolite — it is part of your due diligence.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Pak Rian mau menjual rumahnya di Bintaro, harga penawaran Rp 1,2 miliar.
segments.tr: Mr. Rian wants to sell his house in Bintaro, asking price Rp 1.2 billion.

segments.src: Ia titipkan ke empat agen sekaligus tanpa kontrak tertulis, karena "biar cepat laku".
segments.tr: He entrusts it to four agents at once without a written contract, because "so it sells fast."

segments.src: Tiga bulan berlalu.
segments.tr: Three months pass.

segments.src: Rumah itu tayang di marketplace dengan empat harga: Rp 1,2 M, Rp 1,25 M, Rp 1,19 M, dan satu lagi tanpa harga.
segments.tr: The house is listed on the marketplace with four prices: Rp 1.2B, Rp 1.25B, Rp 1.19B, and another one without a price.

segments.src: Calon pembeli yang serius mundur — mereka menyimpulkan penjualnya bingung atau rumahnya bermasalah.
segments.tr: Serious potential buyers back off — they conclude the seller is confused or the house has problems.

segments.src: Pak Rian akhirnya memilih satu agen dengan listing eksklusif 4 bulan, komisi 2,5%, dibayar saat AJB tuntas.
segments.tr: Mr. Rian finally chooses one agent with a 4-month exclusive listing, 2.5% commission, paid when the AJB is completed.

segments.src: Hitungannya lugas:
segments.tr: The math is straightforward:

segments.src: Rp 30 juta terasa besar.
segments.tr: Rp 30 million feels big.

segments.src: Tapi lihat apa yang terjadi kemudian.
segments.tr: But look at what happens next.

segments.src: Saat pengecekan dokumen, ketahuan sertifikat masih atas nama almarhum ayah Pak Rian.
segments.tr: During document checks, it turns out the certificate is still in the name of Mr. Rian's late father.

segments.src: Kalau transaksi jalan terus tanpa balik nama waris, AJB tidak bisa dibuat dan uang pembeli bisa tertahan berbulan-bulan.
segments.tr: If the transaction keeps going without inheritance name transfer, the AJB cannot be made and the buyer's money could be stuck for months.

segments.src: Agen menahan proses, mengurus surat keterangan waris lebih dulu.
segments.tr: The agent halts the process, taking care of the certificate of inheritance first.

segments.src: Berikutnya, calon pembeli menawar dan minta mentransfer tanda jadi Rp 50 juta ke rekening pribadi agen "biar praktis".
segments.tr: Next, the potential buyer negotiates and asks to transfer a Rp 50 million booking fee to the agent's personal account "for convenience."

segments.src: Agen menolak, dan mengarahkan pembayaran melalui rekening penjual dengan kuitansi bermeterai serta perjanjian pengikatan jual beli di notaris.
segments.tr: The agent refuses, and directs payment through the seller's account with a stamped receipt and a conditional sale and purchase agreement at the notary.

segments.src: Bandingkan ongkosnya.
segments.tr: Compare the costs.

segments.src: Komisi Rp 30 juta adalah biaya yang diketahui di depan.
segments.tr: A Rp 30 million commission is a cost known upfront.

segments.src: Sengketa waris yang meledak setelah uang berpindah bisa menahan aset Rp 1,2 miliar selama satu-dua tahun di pengadilan, ditambah biaya pengacara.
segments.tr: An inheritance dispute that explodes after money changes hands can hold up a Rp 1.2 billion asset for one to two years in court, plus lawyer fees.

segments.src: Itulah alasan komisi bukan sekadar bayaran untuk "mempertemukan orang" — ia bayaran untuk verifikasi yang bikin transaksi selamat.
segments.tr: That is the reason commission is not just payment for "bringing people together" — it is payment for verification that keeps the transaction safe.

segments.src: Catatan penting: kalau agen Anda hanya sibuk memotret rumah dan tidak pernah menyebut sertifikat, PBB, atau status perkawinan penjual, Anda sedang membayar 2,5% untuk jasa fotografi.
segments.tr: Important note: if your agent is only busy taking pictures of the house and never mentions certificates, land tax (PBB), or the seller's marital status, you are paying 2.5% for photography services.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Perjanjian listing menentukan harga, jangka waktu, dan komisi; listing terbuka tanpa kontrak justru sering membuat harga jadi kacau dan pembeli mundur.
segments.tr: 1. Listing agreements determine price, duration, and commission; open listings without contracts often make prices chaotic and buyers back off.

segments.src: 2. Berdasarkan Permendag No. 51/2017, komisi perantara properti minimal 2% dari nilai transaksi dan dibayar pemberi tugas — dan titik "kapan komisi lahir" harus ditulis sejak awal.
segments.tr: 2. Based on Trade Minister Regulation No. 51/2017, property broker commission is a minimum of 2% of the transaction value and paid by the assigning party — and the point of "when commission is earned" must be written from the start.

segments.src: 3. Nilai terbesar seorang agen ada di pencegahan sengketa: cek sertifikat ke BPN, cocokkan nama pemilik, pastikan persetujuan pasangan, dan jangan pernah kirim uang ke rekening pribadi agen.
segments.tr: 3. An agent's greatest value lies in dispute prevention: checking certificates at BPN, matching owner names, ensuring spouse consent, and never sending money to an agent's personal account.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terminology

segments.src: - **Listing eksklusif** — perjanjian yang memberi hak pemasaran kepada satu agen saja untuk jangka waktu tertentu.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive listing** — an agreement that grants marketing rights to a single agent only for a certain period.

segments.src: - **Komisi perantara** — imbalan jasa agen, minimal 2% dari nilai transaksi menurut Permendag No. 51/2017, dibayar oleh pemberi tugas.
segments.tr: - **Brokerage commission** — agent service fee, minimum 2% of the transaction value according to Trade Minister Regulation No. 51/2017, paid by the assigning party.

segments.src: - **PPJB** — Perjanjian Pengikatan Jual Beli; perjanjian pendahuluan saat syarat jual beli (misalnya pelunasan atau balik nama) belum terpenuhi.
segments.tr: - **PPJB** — Conditional Sale and Purchase Agreement (Perjanjian Pengikatan Jual Beli); a preliminary agreement when sale and purchase conditions (such as full payment or name transfer) have not been met.

segments.src: - **AJB** — Akta Jual Beli; akta peralihan hak yang dibuat di hadapan PPAT dan menjadi dasar balik nama sertifikat.
segments.tr: - **AJB** — Deed of Sale and Purchase (Akta Jual Beli); a deed of rights transfer made before a PPAT and serving as the basis for certificate name transfer.

segments.src: - **PPAT** — Pejabat Pembuat Akta Tanah; pejabat berwenang membuat akta peralihan hak atas tanah dan bangunan.
segments.tr: - **PPAT** — Land Deed Making Official (Pejabat Pembuat Akta Tanah); an official authorized to make deeds of rights transfer on land and buildings.

segments.src: - **SIU-P4** — Surat Izin Usaha Perusahaan Perantara Perdagangan Properti; izin usaha yang wajib dimiliki kantor agen properti resmi.
segments.tr: - **SIU-P4** — Property Brokerage Company Business License (Surat Izin Usaha Perusahaan Perantara Perdagangan Properti); a business license that official real estate agent offices must have.

id-20260816-news-2.title: Danantara Disburses Rp225 Trillion for 26 Projects, Partners with Brazilian Meat Giant JBS Worth Rp44.6 Trillion

segments.src: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara) dilaporkan terus memperluas jejak investasinya di berbagai sektor strategis.
segments.tr: The Daya Anagata Nusantara Investment Management Agency (Danantara) is reportedly continuing to expand its investment footprint across various strategic sectors.

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang beredar, lembaga pengelola aset negara ini telah menggelontorkan dana hingga sekitar Rp225 triliun untuk mendukung 26 proyek yang tersebar di berbagai bidang, mulai dari hilirisasi sumber daya alam hingga ketahanan pangan.
segments.tr: Based on circulating information, this state asset management institution has disbursed funds of up to approximately Rp225 trillion to support 26 projects spread across various fields, ranging from natural resource downstreaming to food security.

segments.src: ## Kemitraan dengan JBS Group
segments.tr: ## Partnership with JBS Group

segments.src: Salah satu langkah yang menyita perhatian publik adalah rencana kemitraan dengan JBS Group, perusahaan pengolahan daging asal Brasil yang dikenal sebagai salah satu pemain terbesar di industri protein hewani dunia.
segments.tr: One move that has captured public attention is the planned partnership with JBS Group, a meat processing company from Brazil known as one of the largest players in the global animal protein industry.

segments.src: Nilai kerja sama ini disebut-sebut mencapai sekitar Rp44,6 triliun, dan menjadi bagian dari upaya Danantara memperkuat portofolio di sektor pangan dan hilirisasi.
segments.tr: The value of this collaboration is said to reach approximately Rp44.6 trillion, and it is part of Danantara's efforts to strengthen its portfolio in the food and downstreaming sectors.

segments.src: Kolaborasi dengan JBS ini dipandang sebagai langkah untuk memperkuat rantai pasok protein nasional, mengingat kebutuhan konsumsi daging dalam negeri yang terus meningkat seiring pertumbuhan penduduk.
segments.tr: The collaboration with JBS is seen as a step to strengthen the national protein supply chain, given the domestic demand for meat consumption that continues to rise alongside population growth.

segments.src: Jika terealisasi, kemitraan ini berpotensi membuka peluang transfer teknologi pengolahan, standar keamanan pangan, hingga perluasan kapasitas produksi di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: If realized, this partnership has the potential to open up opportunities for processing technology transfer, food safety standards, and the expansion of domestic production capacity.

segments.src: ## Fokus pada Hilirisasi dan Ketahanan Pangan
segments.tr: ## Focus on Downstreaming and Food Security

segments.src: Selain kerja sama dengan JBS, sebagian besar dari total dana yang telah disalurkan Danantara disebut diarahkan pada proyek-proyek hilirisasi, termasuk pengolahan komoditas sumber daya alam menjadi produk bernilai tambah lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: In addition to the cooperation with JBS, a large portion of the total funds already disbursed by Danantara is said to be directed at downstreaming projects, including the processing of natural resource commodities into higher value-added products.

segments.src: Strategi ini sejalan dengan agenda besar pemerintah untuk mengurangi ketergantungan pada ekspor bahan mentah dan mendorong industrialisasi di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: This strategy is in line with the government's major agenda to reduce dependence on raw material exports and encourage domestic industrialization.

segments.src: Sektor pangan turut menjadi perhatian khusus, mengingat isu ketahanan pangan nasional yang kerap menjadi topik penting dalam kebijakan ekonomi jangka panjang.
segments.tr: The food sector is also receiving special attention, given the issue of national food security, which is often an important topic in long-term economic policy.

segments.src: Investasi di sektor ini diharapkan dapat membantu menstabilkan pasokan sekaligus menekan ketergantungan pada impor sejumlah komoditas pangan strategis.
segments.tr: Investment in this sector is expected to help stabilize supply while reducing dependence on imports of a number of strategic food commodities.

segments.src: ## Sorotan terhadap Tata Kelola
segments.tr: ## Spotlight on Governance

segments.src: Di sisi lain, langkah ekspansif Danantara ini muncul di tengah perhatian publik terhadap aspek tata kelola lembaga tersebut.
segments.tr: On the other hand, this expansive move by Danantara comes amidst public attention regarding the governance aspects of the institution.

segments.src: Sejumlah kalangan menyoroti pentingnya transparansi dan akuntabilitas dalam pengelolaan dana investasi berskala besar seperti ini, mengingat dampaknya yang luas terhadap keuangan negara dan kepercayaan investor.
segments.tr: A number of parties have highlighted the importance of transparency and accountability in managing large-scale investment funds like this, given their broad impact on state finances and investor confidence.

segments.src: Pengamat ekonomi menilai bahwa penguatan mekanisme pengawasan, pelaporan yang terbuka, serta kejelasan kriteria pemilihan mitra investasi menjadi hal krusial agar setiap proyek yang didanai dapat memberikan manfaat optimal bagi perekonomian nasional.
segments.tr: Economic observers assess that strengthening oversight mechanisms, open reporting, and clarity in the criteria for selecting investment partners are crucial so that every funded project can provide optimal benefits for the national economy.

segments.src: Hal ini dianggap penting terutama karena skala dana yang dikelola terus bertambah seiring bertambahnya jumlah proyek strategis yang digarap.
segments.tr: This is considered important especially because the scale of funds managed continues to grow along with the increasing number of strategic projects being undertaken.

segments.src: ## Prospek ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Outlook

segments.src: Dengan total investasi yang telah mencapai ratusan triliun rupiah untuk puluhan proyek, langkah Danantara ke depan akan terus dipantau berbagai pihak, baik dari sisi pelaku pasar, akademisi, maupun masyarakat umum.
segments.tr: With total investments already reaching hundreds of trillions of rupiah for dozens of projects, Danantara's future steps will continue to be monitored by various parties, including market players, academics, and the general public.

segments.src: Keberhasilan kemitraan seperti dengan JBS Group berpotensi menjadi tolok ukur bagaimana lembaga ini mengelola investasi lintas sektor, sekaligus menjawab tantangan terkait tata kelola yang selama ini menjadi sorotan.
segments.tr: The success of partnerships such as the one with JBS Group has the potential to become a benchmark for how this institution manages cross-sector investments, while simultaneously addressing the challenges related to governance that have been in the spotlight.

segments.src: Perkembangan lebih lanjut mengenai realisasi proyek-proyek ini, termasuk detail teknis kerja sama dengan JBS, diperkirakan akan terus bergulir dan menjadi perhatian dalam beberapa waktu ke depan.
segments.tr: Further developments regarding the realization of these projects, including technical details of the cooperation with JBS, are expected to continue to unfold and become a focus in the time to come.

id-20260816-news-1.title: M7.7 Earthquake Shakes Flores, NTT: Dozens of Casualties, Airports and Ports Completely Paralyzed

segments.src: ## Gempa Besar Guncang Wilayah Utara Nagekeo
segments.tr: ## Major Earthquake Shakes Northern Nagekeo Region

segments.src: Gempa bumi berkekuatan magnitudo 7,7 mengguncang wilayah utara Kabupaten Nagekeo, Nusa Tenggara Timur (NTT), pada Sabtu, 15 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck the northern region of Nagekeo Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), on Saturday, August 15, 2026.

segments.src: Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG) melaporkan bahwa gempa tersebut berpusat di kedalaman dangkal, sehingga guncangannya dirasakan sangat kuat oleh warga di sejumlah kabupaten sekitar, termasuk Ende, Ngada, Sikka, dan Manggarai.
segments.tr: The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) reported that the earthquake was centered at a shallow depth, causing the shaking to be felt very strongly by residents in a number of surrounding regencies, including Ende, Ngada, Sikka, and Manggarai.

segments.src: Karena karakteristik gempa dangkal dengan kekuatan besar, BMKG langsung mengeluarkan **peringatan dini tsunami** untuk wilayah pesisir utara Flores dan sekitarnya tak lama setelah guncangan terjadi.
segments.tr: Due to the characteristics of a shallow earthquake with high magnitude, BMKG immediately issued a **tsunami early warning** for the northern coastal areas of Flores and its surroundings shortly after the shaking occurred.

segments.src: Warga di kawasan pesisir diimbau segera mengungsi ke tempat yang lebih tinggi sesuai prosedur evakuasi bencana.
segments.tr: Residents in coastal areas were urged to immediately evacuate to higher ground in accordance with disaster evacuation procedures.

segments.src: ## Dampak Korban dan Kerusakan
segments.tr: ## Casualties and Damage Impact

segments.src: Berdasarkan data sementara yang dihimpun dari instansi terkait seperti Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD) dan Badan Nasional Penanggulangan Bencana (BNPB), gempa ini dilaporkan menyebabkan **puluhan korban jiwa**, dengan kemungkinan jumlah tersebut masih akan berubah seiring proses pendataan dan pencarian korban yang terus berlangsung.
segments.tr: Based on preliminary data collected from relevant agencies such as the Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD) and the National Disaster Management Authority (BNPB), the earthquake was reported to have caused **dozens of fatalities**, with the possibility that this number may still change as data collection and victim search operations continue.

segments.src: Selain korban jiwa, sejumlah warga dilaporkan mengalami luka-luka dan sebagian bangunan permukiman mengalami kerusakan akibat guncangan kuat maupun dampak susulan gelombang tinggi di kawasan pesisir.
segments.tr: In addition to fatalities, a number of residents were reported injured and some residential buildings suffered damage due to strong shaking and the subsequent impact of high waves in coastal areas.

segments.src: Perlu digarisbawahi bahwa angka resmi korban dan kerusakan masih bersifat sementara.
segments.tr: It should be emphasized that the official figures for casualties and damage are still preliminary.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk merujuk pada rilis resmi dari BNPB, BPBD setempat, dan BMKG guna mendapatkan informasi terkini yang telah terverifikasi.
segments.tr: The public is urged to refer to official releases from BNPB, local BPBD, and BMKG to obtain the latest verified information.

segments.src: ## Infrastruktur Transportasi Lumpuh
segments.tr: ## Transportation Infrastructure Paralyzed

segments.src: Salah satu dampak paling signifikan dari bencana ini adalah lumpuhnya jalur transportasi udara dan laut di kawasan NTT.
segments.tr: One of the most significant impacts of this disaster is the paralysis of air and sea transportation routes in the NTT region.

segments.src: Setidaknya **lima bandara** di wilayah terdampak dilaporkan mengalami kerusakan pada landasan pacu maupun fasilitas terminal, sehingga sementara waktu tidak dapat beroperasi.
segments.tr: At least **five airports** in the affected areas were reported to have suffered damage to their runways and terminal facilities, making them temporarily inoperable.

segments.src: Selain itu, **dua pelabuhan** utama yang menjadi jalur logistik dan penyeberangan antarpulau turut mengalami kerusakan berat pada dermaga dan fasilitas pendukungnya.
segments.tr: In addition, **two main ports** that serve as logistics and inter-island crossing routes also experienced heavy damage to their piers and supporting facilities.

segments.src: Lumpuhnya bandara dan pelabuhan ini berdampak langsung pada terhambatnya distribusi bantuan kemanusiaan serta menyulitkan proses evakuasi warga dari daerah terisolasi.
segments.tr: The paralysis of these airports and ports has a direct impact on hindering the distribution of humanitarian aid and complicating the evacuation process of residents from isolated areas.

segments.src: Otoritas terkait, termasuk Kementerian Perhubungan dan pengelola bandara/pelabuhan setempat, dilaporkan tengah melakukan asesmen cepat terhadap tingkat kerusakan guna mempercepat pemulihan jalur akses.
segments.tr: Relevant authorities, including the Ministry of Transportation and local airport/port operators, are reported to be conducting rapid assessments of the damage level to accelerate the recovery of access routes.

segments.src: ## Upaya Tanggap Darurat
segments.tr: ## Emergency Response Efforts

segments.src: Tim gabungan yang terdiri dari Badan Nasional Pencarian dan Pertolongan (Basarnas), TNI, Polri, BPBD, serta relawan kemanusiaan dilaporkan telah dikerahkan ke lokasi terdampak untuk melakukan pencarian dan evakuasi korban, sekaligus mendistribusikan bantuan darurat berupa logistik, tenda pengungsian, dan layanan medis.
segments.tr: A joint team consisting of the National Search and Rescue Agency (Basarnas), the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI), the National Police (Polri), BPBD, and humanitarian volunteers has reportedly been deployed to the affected locations to search for and evacuate victims, while distributing emergency aid in the form of logistics, evacuation tents, and medical services.

segments.src: Karena akses darat, laut, dan udara yang sebagian besar terputus, proses pengiriman bantuan menghadapi tantangan besar.
segments.tr: Due to land, sea, and air access being largely cut off, the aid delivery process faces major challenges.

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah dilaporkan mengupayakan jalur alternatif, termasuk pemanfaatan helikopter untuk menjangkau wilayah yang paling parah terisolasi.
segments.tr: The local government is reportedly pursuing alternative routes, including the use of helicopters to reach the most severely isolated areas.

segments.src: ## Imbauan bagi Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## Appeal to the Public

segments.src: Warga di wilayah NTT dan sekitarnya diimbau untuk:
segments.tr: Residents in the NTT region and its surroundings are urged to:

segments.src: - Tetap tenang namun waspada terhadap kemungkinan **gempa susulan**.
segments.tr: - Remain calm but alert to the possibility of **aftershocks**.

segments.src: - Mengikuti arahan resmi dari BPBD, BNPB, dan BMKG terkait status peringatan tsunami.
segments.tr: - Follow official directions from BPBD, BNPB, and BMKG regarding the tsunami warning status.

segments.src: - Menghindari kawasan pesisir hingga dinyatakan aman oleh pihak berwenang.
segments.tr: - Avoid coastal areas until declared safe by the authorities.

segments.src: - Memverifikasi informasi hanya melalui kanal resmi pemerintah untuk menghindari berita yang belum terkonfirmasi (hoaks).
segments.tr: - Verify information only through official government channels to avoid unconfirmed news (hoaxes).

segments.src: - Bagi yang memiliki keluarga di wilayah terdampak, dapat menghubungi posko bantuan resmi setempat untuk informasi terbaru.
segments.tr: - For those who have family in the affected areas, they can contact the local official aid post for the latest information.

segments.src: Situasi di lapangan masih terus berkembang, dan pembaruan resmi mengenai jumlah korban, status infrastruktur, serta proses pemulihan akan terus disampaikan oleh instansi berwenang seiring berjalannya waktu.
segments.tr: The situation in the field continues to evolve, and official updates regarding the number of casualties, infrastructure status, and recovery processes will continue to be delivered by authorized agencies over time.

id-20260816-news-3.title: Chili and Rice Compactly Rise in Mid-August 2026, Public Purchasing Power Tested Again

segments.src: ## Inflasi Juli Terkendali, tapi Tekanan Baru Muncul di Agustus
segments.tr: ## July Inflation Controlled, but New Pressure Emerges in August

segments.src: Data inflasi Juli 2026 sempat memberi angin segar bagi perekonomian nasional.
segments.tr: July 2026 inflation data provided a breath of fresh air for the national economy.

segments.src: Harga cabai dan bawang pada periode tersebut tercatat melandai, sehingga laju inflasi bulanan berada dalam rentang yang relatif terkendali.
segments.tr: Chili and onion prices during that period were recorded as easing, so the monthly inflation rate was within a relatively controlled range.

segments.src: Banyak pihak sempat optimistis bahwa tren ini akan berlanjut hingga pertengahan tahun.
segments.tr: Many parties were optimistic that this trend would continue until the middle of the year.

segments.src: Namun optimisme itu kini diuji kembali.
segments.tr: However, that optimism is now being tested again.

segments.src: Memasuki pertengahan Agustus 2026, harga cabai rawit merah dan beras di sejumlah daerah justru menunjukkan tren kenaikan yang cukup terasa di tingkat pasar tradisional maupun ritel modern.
segments.tr: Entering mid-August 2026, the prices of red bird's eye chili and rice in several regions actually show a noticeable upward trend at the traditional market and modern retail levels.

segments.src: Fenomena ini memunculkan pertanyaan besar: apakah stabilitas harga pangan yang sempat tercapai benar-benar solid, atau hanya jeda sementara sebelum tekanan baru muncul?
segments.tr: This phenomenon raises a big question: is the food price stability that was achieved truly solid, or just a temporary pause before new pressure emerges?

segments.src: ## Cabai Rawit Merah Kembali Merangkak Naik
segments.tr: ## Red Bird's Eye Chili Creeps Up Again

segments.src: Berdasarkan pantauan di sejumlah pasar tradisional, harga cabai rawit merah dalam dua pekan terakhir mengalami kenaikan bertahap.
segments.tr: Based on monitoring in several traditional markets, the price of red bird's eye chili has experienced gradual increases over the past two weeks.

segments.src: Pedagang di beberapa daerah mengaku pasokan dari sentra produksi tidak sebanyak biasanya, salah satunya dipicu oleh kondisi cuaca yang kurang mendukung masa panen di sejumlah wilayah sentra cabai.
segments.tr: Traders in several regions admitted that supplies from production centers are not as much as usual, partly triggered by weather conditions that are less supportive of the harvest period in several chili-producing center regions.

segments.src: Selain faktor cuaca, siklus tanam yang belum serentak antarwilayah turut memengaruhi ketersediaan pasokan di pasar.
segments.tr: Besides weather factors, the planting cycle that is not synchronized between regions also affects the availability of supplies in the market.

segments.src: Ketika satu daerah sentra mengalami penurunan produksi, daerah lain belum tentu bisa langsung menutupi kekurangan tersebut karena masa panen yang berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: When one central region experiences a drop in production, other regions may not necessarily be able to immediately cover the shortage due to different harvest periods.

segments.src: Kondisi ini membuat harga cabai rawit merah cenderung fluktuatif dari waktu ke waktu, meski secara umum masih dianggap sebagai pola musiman yang lazim terjadi.
segments.tr: This condition makes the price of red bird's eye chili tend to fluctuate over time, although generally it is still considered a common seasonal pattern.

segments.src: ## Harga Beras Turut Terkerek
segments.tr: ## Rice Prices Also Pulled Up

segments.src: Selain cabai, harga beras di sejumlah daerah juga dilaporkan mengalami kenaikan meski dalam skala yang lebih moderat.
segments.tr: Besides chili, rice prices in several regions are also reported to have increased, albeit on a more moderate scale.

segments.src: Beberapa pedagang beras menyebut kenaikan harga di tingkat penggilingan turut memengaruhi harga jual ke konsumen akhir.
segments.tr: Several rice traders mentioned that price increases at the mill level also affect the selling price to end consumers.

segments.src: Faktor musim tanam, biaya produksi, hingga dinamika stok di tingkat distributor disebut-sebut menjadi penyebab yang saling berkaitan.
segments.tr: Planting season factors, production costs, to stock dynamics at the distributor level are said to be interrelated causes.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga beras kerap mendapat perhatian lebih besar dibanding komoditas lain karena statusnya sebagai bahan pangan pokok yang dikonsumsi hampir seluruh rumah tangga di Indonesia.
segments.tr: The increase in rice prices often gets greater attention compared to other commodities because of its status as a staple food consumed by almost all households in Indonesia.

segments.src: Sedikit saja kenaikan harga beras dapat berdampak luas pada pengeluaran rumah tangga, terutama bagi kelompok masyarakat berpenghasilan menengah ke bawah.
segments.tr: Even a slight increase in rice prices can have a wide impact on household expenditure, especially for lower-middle-income groups.

segments.src: ## Dampak terhadap Daya Beli Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## Impact on Public Purchasing Power

segments.src: Kenaikan harga dua komoditas strategis ini secara bersamaan berpotensi menekan daya beli masyarakat, khususnya menjelang periode belanja rumah tangga bulanan.
segments.tr: The simultaneous price increase of these two strategic commodities has the potential to suppress public purchasing power, especially ahead of the monthly household shopping period.

segments.src: Bagi keluarga dengan anggaran belanja terbatas, kenaikan harga cabai dan beras dapat memaksa penyesuaian pola konsumsi, misalnya mengurangi porsi belanja atau beralih ke jenis atau kualitas komoditas yang lebih terjangkau.
segments.tr: For families with limited shopping budgets, the increase in chili and rice prices can force adjustments in consumption patterns, such as reducing shopping portions or switching to more affordable commodity types or qualities.

segments.src: Pelaku usaha kuliner skala kecil dan menengah, seperti warung makan dan pedagang kaki lima, juga turut merasakan dampaknya.
segments.tr: Small and medium-scale culinary business actors, such as food stalls and street vendors, also feel the impact.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga bahan baku dapat memaksa mereka memilih antara menaikkan harga jual atau menekan margin keuntungan demi mempertahankan pelanggan.
segments.tr: Raw material price increases can force them to choose between raising selling prices or squeezing profit margins in order to retain customers.

segments.src: ## Upaya Menjaga Stabilitas Harga
segments.tr: ## Efforts to Maintain Price Stability

segments.src: Menghadapi dinamika harga pangan yang fluktuatif, pemantauan harga di tingkat pasar dan operasi pasar murah biasanya menjadi salah satu instrumen yang digunakan untuk meredam gejolak harga, khususnya untuk komoditas strategis seperti beras dan cabai.
segments.tr: Facing fluctuating food price dynamics, market-level price monitoring and cheap market operations are usually one of the instruments used to dampen price shocks, especially for strategic commodities like rice and chili.

segments.src: Koordinasi antara pemerintah daerah, distributor, dan pelaku pasar juga kerap ditingkatkan saat harga komoditas pangan menunjukkan tren kenaikan yang berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: Coordination between local governments, distributors, and market players is also often enhanced when food commodity prices show a sustained upward trend.

segments.src: Selain intervensi jangka pendek, perbaikan tata kelola distribusi serta dukungan terhadap petani dalam mengelola masa tanam dan pasca-panen juga menjadi faktor penting untuk menjaga kestabilan pasokan dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Besides short-term interventions, improvements in distribution governance and support for farmers in managing the planting and post-harvest periods are also important factors to maintain supply stability in the long term.

segments.src: Upaya diversifikasi sumber pasokan antardaerah turut disebut sebagai salah satu langkah yang dapat membantu meredam gejolak harga akibat ketimpangan musim panen.
segments.tr: Efforts to diversify inter-regional supply sources are also mentioned as one of the steps that can help dampen price shocks due to harvest season imbalances.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Diperhatikan Konsumen
segments.tr: ## What Consumers Need to Pay Attention To

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, situasi ini menjadi pengingat pentingnya mengelola anggaran belanja dengan lebih cermat.
segments.tr: For the public, this situation is an important reminder to manage shopping budgets more carefully.

segments.src: Beberapa langkah sederhana yang bisa dipertimbangkan antara lain:
segments.tr: Some simple steps that can be considered include:

segments.src: - Memantau harga di beberapa pasar atau platform belanja sebelum membeli dalam jumlah besar.
segments.tr: - Monitoring prices in several markets or shopping platforms before buying in large quantities.

segments.src: - Menyesuaikan porsi konsumsi cabai dengan alternatif seperti cabai kering atau olahan sambal kemasan saat harga cabai segar sedang tinggi.
segments.tr: - Adjusting chili consumption portions with alternatives such as dried chili or packaged chili paste products when fresh chili prices are high.

segments.src: - Membeli kebutuhan pokok secukupnya agar tidak terjadi penumpukan stok yang justru berisiko menambah tekanan permintaan di pasar.
segments.tr: - Buying staple needs in moderation to avoid stock accumulation which actually risks adding demand pressure in the market.

segments.src: ## Menanti Perkembangan Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Awaiting Further Developments

segments.src: Kenaikan harga cabai rawit merah dan beras di pertengahan Agustus 2026 ini masih perlu terus dipantau untuk melihat apakah tren tersebut bersifat sementara akibat faktor musiman, atau justru menjadi sinyal tekanan yang lebih panjang terhadap stabilitas harga pangan nasional.
segments.tr: The increase in the prices of red bird's eye chili and rice in mid-August 2026 still needs to be continuously monitored to see whether the trend is temporary due to seasonal factors, or actually a signal of longer pressure on national food price stability.

segments.src: Yang jelas, keseimbangan antara pasokan, distribusi, dan permintaan tetap menjadi kunci utama agar daya beli masyarakat tidak semakin terbebani menjelang penghujung tahun.
segments.tr: Clearly, the balance between supply, distribution, and demand remains the main key so that public purchasing power is not increasingly burdened towards the end of the year.
